Why students choose APSHULE

📡

Live Online Lessons

Join real-time classes taught by qualified Ugandan teachers. Ask questions, get feedback, and never miss a lesson with recorded replays.

📚

PDF Study Resources

Access a full library of notes, past papers, and revision guides — organised by subject and class level. Download once, study anytime.

🏫

School Management System

Schools can enrol students, track attendance with AI face recognition, manage subscriptions, and monitor academic progress — all from one dashboard.

✅

Smart Attendance Tracking

Automated face-recognition attendance for schools and institutions. Generate daily attendance reports and flag late arrivals automatically.

About APSHULE

APSHULE is a Ugandan digital learning platform built to make quality education accessible to every student across Uganda. Whether you're a primary pupil, secondary student, or school administrator, APSHULE has the tools you need — live classes, study materials, and powerful school management features, all on your phone.

Cartoon Studio

Turn a short English lesson script into a six-scene slideshow with captions and browser voiceover. Generation requires an internet connection; the finished lesson can be cached for offline playback.

    📖 About APSHULE

    Our Vision

    To be Africa's leading digital learning platform transforming education through innovation and accessibility for every student across the continent and beyond.

    Our Mission

    To provide quality, accessible, and affordable education to every student in Uganda and beyond through innovative technology.

    Core Values

    Excellence: Striving for the highest quality in education delivery
    Accessibility: Making education available to all students
    Innovation: Continuously improving our platform
